_doc: Generic voxel tile table (format: docs/VOXEL_TABLE.md), used when the game's TileSource.voxel_table() is empty.
Every tile id below 64 is flat ground coloured by its own pixels; ids 64+ fall back to 'prop' (a low block).
A game replaces this with its own table (a world document's client.voxel, or its TileSource override).
